**What this changes, and why**

**How it was checked**

- [ ] A test or fixture fails without the change and passes with it
- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run test:coverage` and `npm run typecheck` pass
- [ ] An answer that cannot be proven still says so (HEURISTIC or UNKNOWN, never an empty "none")
- [ ] Numbers in the docs come from a run of this change; `docs/COVERAGE.md` is regenerated if the builder changed
- [ ] Examples and fixtures use public or made-up code only
